text: This meeting is booked at ten. It's also booked at one.
Someone on QA filed this. You move a meeting to a new time, and its old slot stays booked.
Checking that by hand means walking through all of this.
And I'd do it twice. Once now, to find out if it's even still happening. And again after I fix it, to see if the fix actually worked.
Reprobe does those checks for me. I give it the bug report and a link, it opens a browser, follows the steps, and tells me whether the bug's there, with a recording to show for it.
RoomPilot is how everyone at Northstar books meeting rooms. If the calendar says a room's taken when it isn't, people just go book somewhere else. So... let's see if Reprobe can find it.
